name: Contract Review Team

zh-CN.name: 合同审查团队
zh-CN.shortDesc: 六名成员协作完成风险与法域并行、独立复核、评分报告和带修订 DOCX 交付。需要用户配置模型服务；合同正文与附件会发送用于分析，结果必须由具备资质的人员复核，能力缺口只生成范围受限报告。

en-US.name: Contract Review Team
en-US.shortDesc: Six-member contract review team with parallel risk and jurisdiction checks, independent re-verification and tracked DOCX delivery. Requires a user-configured model service; contract text and attachments are sent for analysis, results require qualified human review, and capability gaps produce a bounded report.

fullDesc: Six-member contract review team with parallel risk and jurisdiction checks, independent re-verification and tracked DOCX delivery. privacy: 合同正文与附件会发送到用户配置的模型服务进行辅助分析；团队不宣称离线处理或零外发。市场只分发公开 Git 指针，安装后产出必须由具备资质的法务或律师复核，不构成法律意见。
